# Bundled Firebase JS SDK

- Library: Firebase JS SDK 12.19.0 (compat builds: `firebase-app-compat.js`, `firebase-auth-compat.js`, `firebase-app-check-compat.js`; the last one is only loaded when a Firebase App Check site key is configured)
- License: Apache-2.0 (protobuf portions BSD-3-Clause); full text in `LICENSE` in this folder
- Source: https://github.com/firebase/firebase-js-sdk
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/firebase
- Unminified source: the GitHub tag `firebase@12.19.0` of the repository above.

The files were downloaded unmodified from the official Firebase distribution for version 12.19.0, except that the trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=` comment was removed because the source maps are not shipped.
